transcript.t: Tom, my history report is about the telephone.
Alexander Bell. He made the first successful telephone call in 1876.
Before that, how did people send messages quickly?
They used telegrams, which sent signals along wires.
And now we carry phones in our pockets! Can I read your report when it is ready?
Sure. Phones have changed greatly. They can take photos and show maps. I will finish the report on Sunday.
